blocks.html: Options controlling the behavior of a remote joiner query execution.

types.name: throwIfKeyNotFound
types.description: Whether to throw an error if a requested key is not found in the result.

types.name: throwIfRelationNotFound
types.description: Whether to throw an error if a requested relation is not found, or a list of relation names to check.

types.name: initialData
types.description: Initial data to use as the starting dataset for the query instead of fetching from a service.

types.name: initialDataOnly
types.description: Whether to use only the initial data without fetching additional data from services.

types.name: locale
types.description:
The locale to use for the query.
Translation will be applied to the query result based on the locale.

children.name: enable
children.description:
Whether to enable the cache. This is only useful if you want to enable without providing any
other options or if you want to enable/disable the cache based on the arguments.

children.name: key
children.description:
The key to use for the cache.
If a function is provided, it will be called with the arguments as the first argument and the
container as the second argument.

children.name: tags
children.description: The tags to use for the cache.

children.name: autoInvalidate
children.description: Whether to auto invalidate the cache whenever it is possible.

children.name: providers
children.description: The providers to use for the cache.
